scope: Vistorias list page with filters and table
notes: Evaluated the Vistorias management interface at the specified URL. Examined filter controls, action buttons, and table structure. Tested keyboard accessibility and role/label attributes on interactive elements.

findings.observed: Filter buttons (Cidade, Porto, Vistoriador, Status) are styled SPAN elements with cursor:pointer but no role, aria-label, tabindex, or semantic button markup
findings.expected: Interactive elements should have proper role attributes (button or similar), accessible names (via aria-label or text content), and be keyboard accessible (tabindex >= 0 for non-native buttons)
evidence: Snapshot shows generic role for filter elements
No role, tabindex, or aria-label attributes found

findings.observed: Icon-only action button in table rows (eye icon) has no title, aria-label, or any accessible name. Element renders as a web component with shadow DOM.
findings.expected: Icon-only buttons must have an accessible name via title, aria-label, aria-labelledby, or meaningful text content
evidence: Web component has shadow DOM but no accessible name exposed

findings.observed: Row selection checkboxes in the table lack aria-label attributes and have no associated label elements. Checkboxes have no id or name attributes that would associate them with labels.
findings.expected: All form controls should have accessible names via associated label elements, aria-label, aria-labelledby, or other means
evidence: Checkboxes have type='checkbox' but no aria-label
No id/name attributes for label association
